report.description: A c2st Handle ``evaluate_imputation`` made, such as ``c2st_6a7b8c9d``.

names.description: Only these columns. Null means every evaluated column.

offset.description: How many matching columns to skip, for the next page. Null means 0. Constraints: at least 0.

limit.description: Most columns to return, from 1 to 20. Null means 20. Constraints: at least 1; at most 20.

output.description: One page of a C2ST report's columns in full, and the provenance. ``result.get(name)`` finds one column.

warnings.description: Caveats on this result, most actionable first. Empty when there are none.

fields.description: Always exactly `code`, `message`, `columns`, `param`, `hint`, in this order. A row's value at position i is the field named here at i.

rows.description: A caveat on a successful result: it worked, but read this first. One row per record, its values in `fields` order. The i-th schema below describes position i.

anyOf.description: Position 0, `code`: The warning's Error Code. Branch on this, not on ``message``.
Position 1, `message`: What happened and what to do, in one or two sentences.
Position 2, `columns`: Columns the warning concerns, or null.
Position 3, `param`: The argument the warning concerns, or null.
Position 4, `hint`: Library-written advice, or null.

omitted.description: One entry per list that was cut, naming the Operation that returns the rest. Empty when nothing was cut.

fields.description: Always exactly `field`, `shown`, `total`, `operation`, `reason`, in this order. A row's value at position i is the field named here at i.

rows.description: Something left out of a result: a capped list was cut, or a Literal Field withheld. One row per record, its values in `fields` order. The i-th schema below describes position i.

anyOf.description: Position 0, `field`: Name of the list field that was cut, or the path of the Literal Field withheld, such as ``top_values[].value``.
Position 1, `shown`: How many items the list holds; 0 for a withheld Literal Field or cut cells.
Position 2, `total`: How many items exist; for a withheld Literal Field, how many values at that path are null; for cut cells, how many were cut.
Position 3, `operation`: The Operation that returns the rest, or null when no Operation does.
Position 4, `reason`: ``cap`` when a list was cut to its cap; ``literal_policy`` when the Operator's Literal Policy is ``deny``; ``truncated`` when long text cells were cut to their character cap.

offset.description: How many matching columns this page skipped.

columns.description: Matching columns: ``flagged`` ones first, then dataset order. At most 20; when more remain, ``omitted`` counts them and names ``describe_c2st_columns``.

fields.description: Always exactly `column`, `outcome`, `verdict`, `annotations`, `n_observed`, `n_filled`, `score`, in this order. A row's value at position i is the field named here at i.

rows.description: One evaluated column's C2ST result in full. One row per record, its values in `fields` order. The i-th schema below describes position i.

anyOf.description: Position 0, `column`: Column name.
Position 1, `outcome`: What happened: ``tested``, or why the test could not run, as in ``evaluate_imputation``.
Position 2, `verdict`: ``flagged``, ``not_flagged``, or ``no_verdict`` when not tested.
Position 3, `annotations`: Facts qualifying a tested column's score, as in ``evaluate_imputation``. Empty when not tested.
Position 4, `n_observed`: Rows where the column was observed in the source frame.
Position 5, `n_filled`: Rows where the column was missing in the source frame: the rows the imputation filled.
Every number of a tested column.

mean_frame_z.description: The score: the mean of each frame's ``mean_repeat_z``. Near 0 means the filled rows could not be told from the observed ones; about 2 or more means they could.

frame_z_spread.description: Standard deviation of the frames' ``mean_repeat_z``; 0 for one frame.

p_value.description: The one-sided p-value of ``mean_frame_z``, before correction.

p_adjusted.description: The Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value across the report's tested columns. At or below ``thresholds.fdr_alpha`` of ``evaluate_imputation`` is ``flagged``.

frames.description: One result per imputed frame, in order.

fields.description: Always exactly `frame`, `mean_repeat_z`, `repeat_z`, `repeat_z_spread`, `train_accuracy`, `test_accuracy`, `n_test`, `degenerate`, `unseen_category`, in this order. A row's value at position i is the field named here at i.

rows.description: The test on one imputed frame, pooled over its repeats. One row per record, its values in `fields` order. The i-th schema below describes position i.

anyOf.description: Position 0, `frame`: The frame's position, from 0. ``evaluate_imputation`` scores one frame, so this is 0.
Position 1, `mean_repeat_z`: The mean of ``repeat_z``: this frame's score.
Position 2, `repeat_z`: One ``z`` per balanced subsampling repeat, in repeat order: ``(accuracy - 0.5) * 2 * sqrt(n_test)``.
Position 3, `repeat_z_spread`: Standard deviation of ``repeat_z``; 0 for one repeat. Large next to ``mean_repeat_z`` means the mean rests on lucky draws.
Position 4, `train_accuracy`: Mean training accuracy over the repeats. Near 1 beside a ``test_accuracy`` near 0.5 means the classifier memorised rows.
Position 5, `test_accuracy`: Mean held-out accuracy over the repeats; 0.5 is chance.
Position 6, `n_test`: Held-out rows scored in each repeat, half observed and half filled.
Position 7, `degenerate`: True when every repeat's classifier predicted one pile for every row.
Position 8, `unseen_category`: True when a filled row holds a category no observed row does.
Position 6, `score`: The numbers and per-frame results; null unless ``tested``.

provenance.description: The classifier, its parameters, the scikit-learn version and the settings of the run.

classifier_class.description: The classifier's fully qualified class name.

classifier_params.description: Every classifier parameter, defaults included, by name.

fields.description: Always exactly `name`, `value`, in this order. A row's value at position i is the field named here at i.

rows.description: One parameter of the classifier that ran. One row per record, its values in `fields` order. The i-th schema below describes position i.

anyOf.description: Position 0, `name`: Parameter name.
Position 1, `value`: Its value, as text.

sklearn_version.description: The scikit-learn version that produced the numbers.

scheme.description: ``split``: one fit per repeat on a 70/30 carve; ``cross_validation``: five.

min_samples_leaf.description: Fewest rows in a leaf of the classifier.

min_filled_cells.description: The size floor under which a column is ``below_sample_floor``.

low_power_below.description: The pile size under which a tested column is ``low_power``.

imbalance_warn_ratio.description: The pile ratio under which a tested column is ``imbalanced_piles``.
